description_en: This operation performs streaming Q&A on selected documents in a knowledge base, using the conversation history from a specified session as context
description_zh: 本接口在用户选择的文档目录范围内，结合会话内的历史问答作为上下文，提供基于知识库文档的流式问答服务
name: ChatStream

parameters.help_en:
The Q\&A session ID.

Call the `GetChatSessionList` operation to retrieve the IDs of existing sessions.

Alternatively, call the `CreateChatSession` operation to create a new session
parameters.help_zh:
问答会话ID。
可以通过GetSessionList获取历史会话。
也可以通过CreateChatSession创建新的会话
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.example: How to obtain knowledge base Q&A documents
parameters.name: question

parameters.help_en:
A list of document IDs for the Q\&A.


<notice>

  If you specify document IDs, ensure the `sessionId` you provide is not associated with a folder. The session must have been created with an empty folder ID.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
选择文件列表进行问答
<notice>若用户选择传入此参数，请务必保证同时传入的sessionId在创建时填入的文件夹id为空串></notice>
parameters.name: document_ids
